en.ui.loft_cut_targets_tip: The bodies the loft cuts. With none picked, SolidCraft chooses the bodies automatically.
en.ui.loft_join_targets_tip: The bodies the loft joins. With none picked, it joins the shown bodies of the active component it meets.
en.ui.revolve_cut_targets_tip: The bodies the revolution cuts. With none picked, SolidCraft chooses the bodies automatically.
en.ui.revolve_join_targets_tip: The bodies the revolution joins. With none picked, it joins the body its sketch or face is on, or else the shown bodies of the active component.
en.ui.sweep_cut_targets_tip: The bodies the sweep cuts. With none picked, SolidCraft chooses the bodies automatically.
en.ui.sweep_join_targets_tip: The bodies the sweep joins. With none picked, it joins the body its sketch or face is on, or else the shown bodies of the active component.
